property_summary: When _tos has exactly 1 element, the reference contract's loop runs only once (i=0) while the buggy contract runs twice (i=0 and i=1), causing an out-of-bounds array access on _tos[1] that reverts the call; the reference returns true, the buggy call reverts, thus the return value diverges.
change_summary: Change the condition in the for loop from i < _tos.length to i <= _tos.length.
